text: [clean] Examine the object to confirm its current state and location.
[clean] Check if the object is in a receptacle that needs to be opened; open it if necessary.
[clean] Locate a sinkbasin or other cleaning receptacle and use it to clean the object.
[clean] After cleaning, take the object from its current location if not already in hand.
[clean] Put the clean object into the specified target receptacle.
[clean] Verify the task is complete by examining the object or looking at the receptacle.
[cool] Go to the receptacle where the object is likely to be found.
[cool] Open any closed receptacles to check their contents.
[cool] Take the object from its current location once found.
[cool] Go to a cooling receptacle, such as a fridge or sink.
[cool] Cool the object using the appropriate receptacle.
[cool] Put the cooled object into the target receptacle.
[examine] Use the desklamp to illuminate the area before examining the object.
[examine] Go to the receptacle or location where the object is expected to be found.
[examine] Open any closed receptacles that may contain or obscure the object.
[examine] Take the object if it is inside a receptacle to examine it directly.
[examine] Use the "examine" command on the object while under the light of the desklamp.
[examine] If the object is not visible, check all likely receptacles in the room systematically.
[heat] Go to the receptacle containing the object that needs to be heated.
[heat] Open the receptacle if it is closed to access the object.
[heat] Take the object from its current receptacle.
[heat] Go to a heating appliance such as a microwave or stoveburner.
[heat] Use the heating appliance to heat the object.
[heat] Put the heated object into the target receptacle.
[put] Go to the receptacle containing the object first.
[put] Open any closed receptacle if the object is inside.
[put] Take the object from its current receptacle.
[put] Go to the target receptacle where the object should be placed.
[put] Open the target receptacle if it is closed and requires opening.
[put] Put the object in/on the target receptacle.
[puttwo] Search all visible receptacles for the required object.
[puttwo] Open any closed receptacles that might contain the object.
[puttwo] Take the first instance of the object and place it in the target receptacle.
[puttwo] Continue searching until a second instance of the object is found.
[puttwo] Take the second instance and place it in the target receptacle.
[puttwo] Avoid moving objects between receptacles unless necessary to access the target.
